s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive neurological decline with earache and headache
salient_findings: Otitis media, mastoiditis, and local bone destruction in the right ear
Extensive area of hyperintensity with compressed right lateral ventricle on MRI
key_facts: 2 months of progressive right earache and headache
1 week of intermittent hallucinations and nonsensical speech
No obvious manifestation of external ear canal infection
CSF next-generation sequencing positive for Candida tropicalis

shortlist.label: Candida meningitis
shortlist.why_kept: CSF next-generation sequencing positive for Candida tropicalis

shortlist.label: Mastoiditis with intracranial extension
shortlist.why_kept: CT scan of temporal bone showed otitis media, mastoiditis, and local bone destruction in the right ear

shortlist.label: Autoimmune encephalitis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate and C-reactive protein level, and presence of anti-NMDAR and anti-AMPAR1 antibodies

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms of hallucinations, nonsensical speech, and positive test for anti-NMDAR antibodies in both CSF and serum are highly suggestive of NMDAR antibody encephalitis, which is known to cause psychiatric and neurological symptoms.

rejected.label: AMPAR antibody encephalitis
rejected.why: Although the patient is positive for CSF anti-AMPAR1 antibody, the clinical presentation and high titers of anti-NMDAR antibodies are more indicative of NMDAR antibody encephalitis.

rejected.label: Candida meningitis
rejected.why: The presence of Candida tropicalis in CSF next-generation sequencing does not directly correlate with the patient's symptoms, and other findings are not typical for fungal meningitis.

rejected.label: Mastoiditis with intracranial extension
rejected.why: While the patient has mastoiditis, the neurological symptoms and presence of anti-NMDAR antibodies suggest a more complex condition than just local infection spread.

rejected.label: Autoimmune encephalitis
rejected.why: This is a broader category that includes NMDAR antibody encephalitis; the specific antibody positivity makes NMDAR antibody encephalitis a more precise diagnosis.
